description: This file defines a GatewayChatClient class for managing WebSocket-based communication with a gateway server, including connection handling, message sending, session management, and configuration resolution. It also includes functions for resolving connection details based on configuration and environment variables.

classes.name: GatewayChatClient
classes.description: A client class for managing WebSocket connection to a gateway, handling events, sending messages, managing sessions, and connection lifecycle.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a new GatewayChatClient connection using provided options.

methods.name: waitForReady
methods.description: Waits until the client connection is ready.

methods.name: sendChat
methods.description: Sends a chat message through the gateway.

methods.name: loadHistory
methods.description: Loads chat history for a session.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves current status from the gateway.
